decisions.reason: The yogurt on fruit puree builds directly on the firm's core cultured-dairy knowledge, and its award gave management a clear signal it can interpret and refine, so it stays.
A semi-hard cheese wheel is a close extension of the firm's existing cheese production and organic milk supply, so the firm can read its results and improve it with knowledge it already holds.

The mild soft cheese is the last remaining item of a 2018 cheese range whose other new specialties were withdrawn, which raises the risk, but its mild profile sits closer to the firm's core dairy competence than the washed-rind and spiced variants did, so the firm keeps it for now.
